Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about booking, payments, and your stay with StayNeos.

Booking & Reservations

How do I make a reservation?

You can make a reservation by browsing our properties, selecting your dates, and clicking 'Reserve'. You'll need to create an account or log in to complete your booking.

What is the minimum stay requirement?

Our minimum stay is typically 28 nights. However, some properties may have different requirements. Check the specific property listing for details.

Can I book for someone else?

Yes, you can book on behalf of someone else. During checkout, you'll have the option to specify the guest's information.

How do I know if my booking is confirmed?

Once your payment is processed, you'll receive a confirmation email with your booking details and check-in instructions.

Payment & Pricing

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), Google Pay, and bank transfers for corporate clients.

When will I be charged?

Your card will be charged at the time of booking to secure your reservation. For longer stays, we may offer payment plans.

Are there any additional fees?

Our pricing includes all taxes and cleaning fees. You'll see the total price before confirming your booking. Optional services like parking or early check-in may have additional charges.

Is my payment secure?

Yes, we use Stripe for payment processing, which is PCI DSS compliant. Your payment information is never stored on our servers.

Cancellation Policy

What is your cancellation policy?

Full refund for cancellations 30+ days before check-in. 50% refund for cancellations 14-30 days before check-in. No refund for cancellations less than 14 days before check-in.

Can I modify my booking dates?

Yes, date changes are subject to availability and may incur additional fees. Please contact our support team as soon as possible.

What if I need to cancel due to an emergency?

We understand emergencies happen. Contact our support team, and we'll review your case individually. Travel insurance is recommended for such situations.

Check-in & Check-out

What are the standard check-in and check-out times?

Standard check-in is at 3:00 PM and check-out is at 11:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out may be available upon request.

How do I get the keys?

Check-in instructions, including key pickup or access codes, will be sent to your email 24 hours before your arrival.

What if I arrive late at night?

Most of our properties offer self-check-in with key lockboxes or smart locks. Instructions will be provided in your confirmation email.

Property & Amenities

Are the apartments fully furnished?

Yes, all our apartments come fully furnished with quality furniture, kitchen appliances, linens, and toiletries.

Is Wi-Fi included?

Yes, high-speed Wi-Fi is included in all our properties at no additional charge.

Are pets allowed?

Pet policies vary by property. Look for the 'Pet-friendly' tag on listings, or contact us to inquire about specific properties.

Is smoking allowed?

All our properties are non-smoking. Smoking is strictly prohibited and may result in additional cleaning fees.

Support & Contact

How can I contact customer support?

You can reach us via WhatsApp, phone at +1 (647) 862-6518, or email at hello@stayneos.com. Our support team is available 24/7.

What if I have an issue during my stay?

We have a dedicated support team available 24/7. For urgent maintenance issues, we provide emergency contact numbers.

Do you offer corporate housing solutions?

Yes, we specialize in corporate housing with flexible terms, centralized billing, and dedicated account management. Contact us for corporate rates.

Still have questions?

Our team is here to help you 24/7. Reach out to us anytime.
